identity.title: C-SDLC bind topology scan misresolves historical worktree dot records

values.task_boundary: Correct only bind-time topology relevance and its focused tests; do not mutate retained records or widen into migration, claims, publication, finish, or unrelated validation behavior.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Relative stored worktree paths are resolved against canonical repository topology, not an arbitrary scanned worktree projection.
AC-2: An unrelated historical record with worktree dot cannot collide with a new issue-local bind.
AC-3: Topology scanning does not require absent authored artifacts for records proven irrelevant by issue, branch, and canonical worktree identity.
AC-4: A real-binary regression reproduces a #5791-shaped dot-worktree record with absent local artifacts and proves a distinct issue binds successfully.
AC-5: Genuine same-issue, same-branch, and same-canonical-worktree collisions remain fully verified and fail closed with a typed reconciliation error.
AC-6: Any remaining filesystem failure identifies the affected issue and path rather than surfacing raw ENOENT alone.
AC-7: Retained #5791 evidence and unrelated lifecycle surfaces are unchanged.
AC-8: Focused validation, strict Clippy, diff hygiene, and exact-head independent review pass without unresolved findings.
dependencies: Current origin/main C-SDLC v2 bind implementation
Retained #5791 record as read-only defect evidence
Issue #61 live problem and acceptance contract
non_goals: Weakening card verification for a genuinely relevant topology record
Changing claims, leases, migration, publication, finish, or cleanup
